description.value: Deep Cove Winery is a family-owned estate winery nestled between Horth Hill Regional Park and the shores of Deep Cove in North Saanich on the Saanich Peninsula. With three acres of vines planted over 22 years ago, they produce hand-crafted wines including Ortega, Pinot Gris, Marechal Foch, and their signature Alchemy blend. The winery has a lounge with a full food menu and hosts regular events, making it a rewarding stop on a Saanich Peninsula ride.

address.value: 11195 Chalet Road, North Saanich, BC V8L 5M1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Deep Cove Winery is an active family-owned winery in North Saanich with a lounge menu offering food and wine. Address (11195 Chalet Road), phone (250-656-2552), and website all match between OSM and the site. The menu shows several vegetarian items (Mediterranean Hummus Bowl, Margherita Pizza, Baked Spinach & Artichoke Dip). No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags. The business is clearly open with events scheduled into June 2026 and active hiring.
